_about: Player-made maps (src/user_maps/, docs/dev/levels.md 'Player maps'): the MAP SHED's palette and the limits a map file is held to. A cell is one letter of a map's rows; a thing is [kind, name, x, y, facing]. A new entry goes at the END of its list (maps name cells by their letter and things by their name, never by place). Every word here is on screen.
